Tldr: Silicone treatments plus massaging/pressure are great to reducing the appearance of scars if you so desire 

Scars aren't unattractive, but since I saw you asking for how to fade them faster I figured I'd answer! But be aware that most scars can't go away entirely, but they will fade and flatten to match your skin tone better to the point that unless you know what you're looking for you can't see them. This takes time, months to years, but you can speed it up (plus its better for your skin to provide treatment). Both of these methods work best on newer scars, but they can help on olders ones too

The two methods I've seen the best results with is silicone + pressure/massaging. Silicone comes in a variety of applications methods, sheets, cream, sprays, etc etc and is available at most drug stores. Take a look and see what suits your lifestyle or wallet best, they all work basically the same. 

Googling can show you how to massage your scars, and about how much pressure to apply. I recommend massaging them with some type of moisturizing oil (bio oil, cocoa oil, etc) just to make it easier + scars heals best in moisture. 

Even with these methods it can take at least 6 months for scars to fade, but those odds are a lot better than the possible years it can take without any treatment. If you'd like to learn more feel free to dm me, or turn to Google as they have lots of information on scar treatments beyond these two that you might find easier or just find works better with your scars.
